[![BrianHillner](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/d/da/BrianHillner.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/200?cb=20210609113235)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/d/da/BrianHillner.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20210609113235)
**Brian Hillner** is a former [Hot Wheels](/wiki/Hot_Wheels) designer who worked at [Mattel](/wiki/Mattel) from [2007](/wiki/2007) to [2009](/wiki/2009). Initially working as an intern for the Hot Wheels department, Hillner moved to the [Matchbox](/wiki/Matchbox) department where he designed cars until 2009. He currently works for Dassault Systèmes.
